title: A Wife’s “Strange Behavior”
synopsis: Little Wang is in for a surprise when he finds out about his wife’s strange behavior.

fullText.simplified:
老婆的“怪毛病”

    小王和老婆常常吵架。一吵架，老婆就躲进厕所里，半天都不出来。一开始小王觉得没什么，大不了就是在厕所里哭呢。可后来时间长了，小王有点儿好奇了。因为老婆在厕所里能呆好几个小时。小王终于忍不住了，就问老婆：“亲爱的，每次吵完架，你都去厕所里呆着，呆那么长时间，你都干嘛呀？”老婆说：“想知道吗？想知道就说点儿好听的。”
    为了知道老婆的秘密，小王把老婆好好地夸了一顿，什么好听说什么。老婆高兴了，凑到小王的耳边说：“我呀，每次吵完架都去厕所里刷马桶。”小王一听，说：“哦，怪不得马桶那么干净，原来是你的功劳啊。”小王的老婆说：“别夸我！多亏你的牙刷了！
fullText.traditional:
老婆的“怪毛病”

    小王和老婆常常吵架。一吵架，老婆就躲進廁所裡，半天都不出來。一開始小王覺得沒什麼，大不了就是在廁所裡哭呢。可後來時間長了，小王有點兒好奇了。因為老婆在廁所裡能呆好幾個小時。小王終於忍不住了，就問老婆：“親愛的，每次吵完架，你都去廁所裡呆著，呆那麼長時間，你都幹嘛呀？”老婆說：“想知道嗎？想知道就說點兒好聽的。”
    為了知道老婆的秘密，小王把老婆好好地誇了一頓，什麼好聽說什麼。老婆高興了，湊到小王的耳邊說：“我呀，每次吵完架都去廁所裡刷馬桶。”小王一聽，說：“哦，怪不得馬桶那麼乾淨，原來是你的功勞啊。”小王的老婆說：“別誇我！多虧你的牙刷了！

raw.synopsis: Little Wang is in for a surprise when he finds out about his wife’s strange behavior.
sentence_translations: Little Wang and his wife quarrelled frequently.
Every time they quarrelled, his wife would hide in the bathroom and not come out for a long time.
In the beginning, Little Wang thought nothing of it. At worst, she was crying in the bathroom, right?
But later, as the time got longer, Little Wang became a little curious. Because his wife could stay in the bathroom for many hours.
Finally, Little Wang couldn’t help but ask his wife, ..
.. “Darling, every time we finish quarreling, you always go to the bathroom and stay there.”
“Staying in there for such a long time, what are you doing?”
His wife said, “Do you want to know? If you want to know then say something nice.”
In order to know his wife’s secret, Little Wang gave his wife a lot of praise. Whatever sounded nice, he said it.
His wife was happy, and moved closer towards Little Wang’s ear and said, ..
.. “Me? After every argument I go to the bathroom to clean the toilet.”
As soon as Little Wang heard this, he said, “Oh, no wonder the toilet is so clean! It’s all due to your contribution.”
Little Wang’s wife said, “Don’t praise me! Say thanks to your toothbrush!”
